decision.rationale: The audited seed-42 development mean HR@10 is 0.596 for the candidate, 0.59975 for the incumbent, and 0.59075 for the generated control. The candidate exceeds the control by 0.00525 but trails the incumbent by 0.00375, and the supplied readout marks it ineligible for confirmation. Category effects are mixed. The control contrast does not establish the proposed mechanism; no confirmation result is supplied.
unresolved_explanations: LayerNorm placement may change signal scale or optimization without a history-specific benefit.
Single-seed variation and validation checkpoint selection may explain the category-dependent contrast; CDs_and_Vinyl favors the control.
The incumbent readout may already capture useful preceding-state information. History slices are exploratory and lack a control-by-history comparison.

The supplied audited probes do not document every proposed fixed-state formula, history-condition, and post-update forward/scoring check. No independent replication or confirmation result is supplied.
